app.name: Be My Eyes
app.description: Connects blind and low-vision users with volunteers and AI for real-time visual assistance through video calls and photo descriptions.

verdict.one_liner: A well-meaning app with strong security, but your video calls may be shared with third parties for AI research.
verdict.summary: Be My Eyes is a free app that connects blind and low-vision users with sighted volunteers and AI for visual assistance. The app collects standard account info and records video calls, which it may share with third parties for AI development. It does not sell data for ads and offers strong user rights, but the indefinite storage and sharing of video recordings is a notable concern.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app provides a valuable service with transparent privacy practices and strong encryption. However, users should be aware that their video calls may be stored indefinitely and shared with third parties for research purposes. Avoid sharing sensitive personal information during calls.

red.title: Videos may be shared for AI research
red.plain_english: The app may share recordings of your video calls with companies and organizations that are building AI tools for blind and low-vision people. While they try to remove personal details from the file, anything you say or show in the video like your name, address, or face could still be included.

red.title: Call recordings kept indefinitely
red.plain_english: The app stores recordings of your video calls forever unless you specifically ask them to delete them. Even then, they only promise to delete within 30 days of your request.

red.title: Cookies and analytics track website visits
red.plain_english: Their website uses cookies from Google Analytics, YouTube, and HubSpot to track how you browse. This is separate from the app itself, but it does mean your web visits are monitored.

red.title: Video sharing may count as data sale
red.plain_english: The company admits that sharing your videos with third parties for research could legally be considered a sale of personal data under privacy laws, even though they do not receive payment specifically for your data.

green.title: No selling data for ads or tracking
green.plain_english: The app explicitly promises it does not sell your personal information to advertisers, marketers, or tracking companies. That is rare and worth noting.

green.title: Videos encrypted in transit and storage
green.plain_english: Your video calls and photos are scrambled with encryption while they are being sent and while they are stored. This makes it much harder for hackers to view them if they break in.

green.title: Strong deletion and privacy rights for all users
green.plain_english: No matter where you live, you can ask to see your data, fix it, move it, restrict its use, or delete it entirely. You can also opt out of having your videos shared with third parties.

green.title: AI photos and queries not used to train AI
green.plain_english: When you use the AI photo description feature, your pictures and questions are only used to answer your specific question. They are not saved or used to teach AI systems.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The app uses your camera and microphone during video calls, which is the entire point of the service. However, these calls are recorded and stored on the company's servers indefinitely unless you ask for deletion.
categories.detail: Video calls are the core feature. Calls are recorded and stored for service provision, safety, enforcement, and improvement. Recordings are encrypted in transit and at rest. Users can request deletion.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect and store the video calls, photos, audio that pass through our Service (i) to provide our Services; (ii) to enforce our Terms of Service, (iii) to promote and preserve safety, and (iv) to improve our Services and create new Services.
concerns: Calls recorded and stored indefinitely by default
May be shared with third parties for AI research

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The app collects your country and time zone to match you with volunteers who speak your language and are awake when you are. It also gets a rough idea of your location from your internet address.
categories.detail: Country of residence and time zone are collected at registration. General geographic location is derived from IP address. Used for language/timezone matching, not for precise tracking or ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use location and language data to make appropriate connections between blind or low-vision users and volunteers.
concerns: IP address used for general location inference

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The app does not ask for or access your phone contacts.
categories.detail: No mention of contacts or phonebook access in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You can choose to send photos to the AI for description. These photos are processed and then deleted after 60 days, or sooner if you ask.
categories.detail: User-initiated photo uploads to Be My AI. Photos and queries deleted 60 days after creation, or within 30 days of user request. Not used to train AI models.
categories.policy_excerpt: Be My Eyes deletes Be My AI inquiries 60 days after creation, or within 30 days from receiving request from Blind or Low Vision user.
concerns: Photos processed by third-party AI provider in the United States

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: The company may share your video call recordings with outside companies and organizations for AI research. They remove file details like your name, but anything visible or said in the video itself could still be seen by those partners.
categories.detail: Videos may be licensed/shared with educational, non-profit, and for-profit companies for AI and accessibility research. Metadata is stripped but personal information visible in video content may remain. Partners must keep videos confidential, secure, and destroy them after use. Users can opt out by email.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may license or otherwise share recorded video calls to other organizations that are performing research or working to develop products and services, including AI... We strip personal information from the file data associated with the videos we share. We also use available tools to try to identify videos with sensitive personal information and exclude them.
concerns: Personal info visible in videos may be shared
Opt-out is manual via email only

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You need an account with your name, email, and language preferences to use the app. You can also sign in with Facebook, Google, or Apple if you prefer.
categories.detail: Name, email, preferred language(s), country, time zone, and device model/OS collected at registration. SSO supported. Data stored and processed in the United States.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you register for Be My Eyes through our app, we collect the following information to create your account, provide our Services, provide customer support, and contact you: Your name, Your email address, Your preferred language(s), Your country of residence and time zone, The model(s) and operating system information of the device(s) you use.
concerns: Data stored in the United States
Phone number may be required for SMS verification (hashed)

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The app itself does not track your behavior for ads. However, their website uses Google Analytics and other tools to see how people browse, though they say this is not connected to your account.
categories.detail: No ad tracking or behavioral profiling within the app. Website uses Google Analytics and third-party cookies. Analytics data is not connected to user accounts or personal information.
categories.policy_excerpt: Be My Eyes does not sell the personal data we collect to third parties for advertising, marketing, or tracking... The analytics data we receive are not connected to your account or correlated with your personal information.
concerns: YouTube and HubSpot cookies on website

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The app is not for children under 18. If they learn a child has signed up, they will delete that child's information.
categories.detail: Explicitly not directed at children under 18. Will promptly delete personal information if learned to be from a child under 18.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our services are not directed to, and we do not intend to, or knowingly, collect or solicit personal information from children under the age of 18... If we learn that any personal information we collect has been provided by a child under the age of 18, or the applicable higher age of digital consent, we will promptly delete that personal information.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app logs your internet address and how you use the service to keep things running smoothly and securely. This browsing data is not linked to your personal account.
categories.detail: IP address, device identifiers, traffic/usage data, call length, Wi-Fi vs mobile network, and browsing behavior collected via cookies and similar technologies. Analytics data not connected to account.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use cookies, pixels, SDKs, and similar technologies to collect usage and analytics data when you use our Services. This information is primarily used to keep our Services running securely and reliably, and to help us understand how they are being used so we can make improvements.
concerns: Browsing behavior tracked via third-party analytics

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The app collects basic details about your device like its model and operating system to help match you with volunteers and keep the app working.
categories.detail: Device name, model, operating system, language/region settings, and device identifiers collected. Used for service provision and technical support, not for ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: The model(s) and operating system information of the device(s) you use to make or answer calls using our app.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The app does not collect health or biometric data directly. They actually warn you not to share sensitive health information during calls.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collected. Policy explicitly warns users not to share medicines, health conditions, or other sensitive personal information during calls.
categories.policy_excerpt: Don't share information about your medicines, health conditions, or other sensitive personal information.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The app is completely free and does not handle any payment information.
categories.detail: App is free. No payment data collected or processed.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You have excellent control over your data. You can ask to see, fix, move, restrict, or delete your information at any time by emailing them. You can also opt out of having your videos shared.
categories.detail: GDPR/CCPA-style rights applied to all users globally: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, data portability, withdrawal of consent. Deletion requests honored without undue delay. Video sharing opt-out available by email. Account deletion closes account.
categories.policy_excerpt: Be My Eyes applies the privacy rights required by GDPR and various US state laws to all our users, volunteers, and visitors to our website. You can find those rights below under the heading 'Control Over Your Information.'

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: If they make important changes to this policy, they will tell you by email or post a notice on the app. If you keep using the app after that, it means you agree to the new rules.
categories.detail: Material changes notified by email to registered address, prominent posting on Services, or other appropriate channels. Continued use constitutes agreement.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we make material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you by email to your registered email address, by prominent posting on our Services, or through other appropriate communication channels. All changes shall be effective from the date of publication unless otherwise provided.
concerns: Continued use equals acceptance of changes
